title: Sequence to function with general language models: code, test sets and model outputs
description:
Code, test sets, raw model outputs and draft manuscript for four sequence-only tests of general-purpose language models (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Opus 4.6, with a Gemini extension) on protein sequences: next-residue prediction against shuffled controls, naming of Pfam domains, transmembrane helices and signal peptides, detection of single catalytic-residue substitutions, and prediction of secondary structure, contacts and function for recent structures stratified by prior homology.

Running just check verifies the checksums of every test set and model output and re-runs the scoring scripts to reproduce the reported numbers without network or model access.
